$comment: How model-calibrate.mjs judges a routing slot. Edit freely; every preview records this file's digest. Default source aa: metrics are Artificial Analysis API fields, 0-1 values scaled to 0-100, parity within parityTolerance points. source arena: one board from the LMArena leaderboard dataset (config/category), exact model and effort only; better needs non-overlapping intervals, parity needs overlap and a gap within arenaParityElo, and ratings under arenaMinVotes votes are ignored. Cost is always AA weighted USD per task. --apply refuses when the registry is older than maxRegistryAgeHours or a benchmark snapshot older than maxBenchmarkAgeHours. A row with no metrics or protected=true is reported but never proposed.
